title: davallia imrayana
intro: Davallia imrayana, commonly known as the Himalayan Chain Fern or Himalayan Davallia, is a type of fern that belongs to the Davalliaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Ayurveda and Unani, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce fever, cure skin diseases, and treat various respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Davallia imrayana are attributed to its ability to balance the body's energy, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
